WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     date_diff('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14')) -

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
       ELSE strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
     END AS birth_date
WITH nationality,
     date_part('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', birth_date) -
     CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > 10
         OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = 10 AND date_part('day', birth_date) > 14)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN
         CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
     END AS birth_year,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN
         CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
           WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
           WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
           WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
           WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
         END
       ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
     END AS birth_month,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN
         CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ', ', 1), ' ', 2) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
     END AS birth_day
WITH nationality,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
